tldr: Admins invite staged users from the members grid. The invite moves each staged member to invited and sends the email, keeping its role, collections and groups.
goal: Admins cannot invite a staged member without reconfiguring it. This change adds an invite that keeps the provisioned access.

story.heading: Admin Console adds the staged invite command
story.body: The command moves each staged member to invited and sends the invite email.

story.heading: Entity Framework adds the email read
story.body: The repository reads members of one organization by a list of emails.

story.heading: Dapper adds the same email read to SQL Server
story.body: The SQL Server repository calls the new stored procedure with a table of emails.

story.heading: API adds the send-invite endpoint
story.body: The send-invite endpoint returns one result per requested member.

story.heading: Stored procedure reads members by email
story.body: The procedure returns organization user rows whose email is in the list.

story.heading: Admins invite staged members without changing their access
story.body: Staged members become invited and receive an email, keeping role, collections and groups.

components.summary: Adds POST send-invite, which invites the selected staged members.
Moves staged members to invited, sends invites, and reverts them on send failure.
Reads organization members by a list of emails through a stored procedure.
Reads organization members by a list of emails.
Adds a stored procedure that reads members by organization and email.

decisions.title: Skip ineligible members instead of failing the request
decisions.why: Each skipped member gets its own result, and the other members in the request still run.
decisions.alternative: Reject the whole request on any ineligible member.

decisions.title: Keep seat expansion all-or-nothing
decisions.why: Seats are reserved once for the whole eligible set, so a seat shortfall fails the whole invite.
decisions.alternative: Reserve seats for each member separately.

decisions.title: Add a separate endpoint for staged invites
decisions.why: The email-keyed Invite cannot tell a staged member apart from a new one by email alone.

decisions.title: Revert staged members when the invite email fails
decisions.why: A failed email send returns the members to staged with their previous revision dates.
decisions.alternative: Keep the members invited after a failed send.
